content: Xoossan Doorettida Dere

GODAA intte Xoossay intte laattanaas biza biittayo inttena gelththiza wode qasseka inttefe wolqqamizanne minniza laappun kawoteththata heytikka Hiiteta, Gergeseta, Amooreta, Kanaaneta, Paarizeta, Hiiwetanne Yaabuseta intte sinththafe dhoqalli dhayssana.
GODAA intte Xoossay he dereta intte kushen aaththi immiin intte istta xooniza wode istta kumeth suppu histti dhayssite attiin isttara ay qaalakka gelopitenne isttas qadhettofte.
Isttara ekettoftenne gelettofte; intte macca nayta istta attuma naytas immofte; istta macca naytakka intte attuma naytas ekkofte.

Gaasoykka intte hessaththo ooththontta aggiko istti intte nayta GODAA kaallizasoppe betissidi eeqa xoossata kaallana mala ooththana; he wode GODAA hanqoy eexxi kezananne izi inttena heerakka eeson dhayssana.

Hessa gishshas intte istti yarsho yarshizasoza laallite; istti goynniza tuussa malata shuchchata kinchchereththi yeggite; Asheero geetettiza eeqa xoossay misleza tinchchereththi yeggite; masetti giigida eeqa xoossata misletakka taman xuuggite.
Gaasoykka GODAA intte Xoossay inttena baas gidana mala doorida dumma dere; biitta bolla diza dere ubbaafe intte izas dumma dere gidana mala doorettideta.
GODAY inttena siiqidaynne dooriday intte hara asaappe qoodan dariza gishshas gidenna; intte hara deraappe qoodan keehi guuththata.

Gido attiin GODAY inttena siiqida gishshassinne kase intte aawatas gelida hidota qaala naaganaas koyida gishshas izi inttena Gibxe kawos aylleteththan diza Gibxe biittafe ba gita wolqqan wozzidi kessides.

Hessa gishshas GODAA intte Xoossay mulera ammanettida Xoossaa gididayssa intte yuushshi qopite; izi ba caaqqida qaalaa naagees; iza dosizaytassinne iza azazo polizaytas ubbaas shii yeleta gakkanaas izi ba mernaa siiqo bessana.
Gido attiin bana ixxizayta ba halo kessana; istta bolla ba halo kessanaas gam7enna.
Hessa gishshas ta hach inttena azaziza azazota, wogatanne maarata lo7eththi naagite.
Azazeteththan Beettiza Anjjo
Intte ha azazota, wogatanne maarata siyidi lo7eththi naagikko GODAA intte Xoossay kase intte aawatas gelida caaqo qaalanne ba mernaa siiqo intteska minththana.

Izi inttena siiqana; anjjananne qoodan darsana; qasseka izi intte aawatas caaqqida biittayn intte yelota, intte biittay immiza ayfeta, kaththaa, woynenne wogara zayte, intte mehetanne dorsa wudeta ubbaa darssidi anjjana.
Intte mala anjjettida derey alame bolla mulekka deenna; intte giddofe macca gidiin woykko attumas gidiin hessaththoka intte meheta giddon maynney beettenna.
GODAY harge ubbaafe inttena naagana; intte kase Gibxen dishe be7ida iita hargetappe awoyssaka intte bolla ehenna; gido attiin izi bana ixxizayta bolla he hargeta ehana.
GODAA intte Xoossay intte kushen aaththi immida dereta ubbaasikka qadhettontta dhayssite; inttes woximade gidontta mala istta eeqa xoossatas goynnofte.
Intte intte wozinan, «Ha kawoteththati nuuppe minneettes; histtiin nu istta wostti dhayssanee?» giidi qoppontta aggeketa.
Gido attiin intte isttas yayyofte; GODAA intte Xoossay Gibxe kawo bollanne he dere asaa ubbaa bolla ooththidayssa yuushshi qopite.

GODAA intte Xoossay inttena Gibxeppe kessiza wode ooththida gita boshata, malaatata, malalisiza miishshata, iza mino qesetanne micettida kusheta intte intte ayfen be7ideta; ha7i intte yayyiza asa ubbaa bollankka GODAA intte Xoossay hessaththo ooththana.
GODAA intte Xoossay istta giddon shiro denththana;
inttefe baqatidi qotettidaytikka heera dhayana.
Hessa gishshas he deretas babofte; GODAA intte Xoossay inttenara dees; izi gitanne yashissiza Xoossa.
GODAA intte Xoossay hayta kawoteththata guuththara guuththara shoddi kessana; intte istta ubbaa issito dhayssofte; intte issito dhayssiko biitta bolla do7ay daridi inttena waayisana.
GODAA intte Xoossay intte morkketa intte kushen aaththi immana; istti ubbay wurana gakkanaas izi istta garsan shiro denththana.
Qasseka istta kawota izi intte kushen aaththi immana; intte istta sunththaa mulera biittafe dhayssana; intte istta dhayssana gakkanaas inttenara eqetti dandayana ay asikka deenna.

Istta eeqa xoossata ubbaa taman xuuggite; he eeqa xoossata bolla diza worqqanne bira amottidi inttes ekkofte; GODAA intte Xoossay eeqa xoossatas goyno ixxiza gishshas intte ekkiko izi inttes woximade gidana.
Ha tunida eeqa xoossata intteso gelththofte; intte intteso gelththiko istti dhayzayssaththo intteka dhayana; istti dhayanaas bessiza gishshas intte istta ixxitenne harasettite.

footnotes.text: Shiro denththana gizayssa bosha yeddana woykko saxxiza udunxxe yeddana gaana dandayettees.
